ms: Adik tendang bola. Ibu baca buku. Ayah pakai topi hitam. Kami lihat peta. Batu itu besar.
Adik ada meja. Ibu kemas katil. Ayah buka pintu. Pensel itu di atas meja. Kami duduk di atas tikar.
Ia suka duduk di atas tikar.
Kucing itu di atas tikar. Kucing itu berwarna hitam. Ia suka duduk di atas tikar yang lembut. Tikar itu di ruang tamu.
en: The cat sat on the mat.
The cat sat on the mat. A bat sat on the hat. Dad got the map and the van.
The hen sat on a nest.
The fish is in the net.
I sleep in my bed. I write with a pen. The hen is in the net. We sleep in the tent.
The cat is on the mat.
It likes to sit on the soft mat.
The cat is on the mat. It is a black cat. It likes to sit on the soft mat. The mat is in the living room.
